items.title: Meta enters the enterprise AI battle
items.summary: The Mark Hang panel discusses Meta's (META) moving into the enterprise space, igniting competition with giants Microsoft (MSFT) and Alphabet (GOOGL, GOOG).

items.title: Trust the customers, not the loudest online critics: Stagwell CEO
items.summary: Stagwell CEO, former Microsoft Chief Strategy Officer, and White House pollster Mark Penn explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi why marketers need to distinguish broad consumer response from a small, vocal online niche before abandoning an effective campaign.

items.title: Why most ads are terrible: Former Microsoft CSO
items.summary: Stagwell CEO, former Microsoft Chief Strategy Officer, and White House pollster Mark Penn sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to break down why most modern digital ads fail, and how AI is completely rewriting the rules of what you buy.

items.title: Microsoft, Oracle Stocks Tumble After Meta Unveils New AI Enterprise Push
items.summary: Meta's push into enterprise software sparked a broad selloff among major technology companies with established business software operations

items.title: Top software application stocks to watch, according to Oppenheimer
items.summary: Investing.com -- Oppenheimer analysts say the artificial intelligence transition in software has moved beyond experimentation and into a phase where companies must demonstrate measurable returns on investment. Enterprise AI spending remains strong, but customers and investors now focus on business outcomes rather than adoption metrics alone. AI is becoming a recurring operating expense, with chief financial officers evaluating investments alongside labor costs and demanding clear returns.

items.title: Arm Stock Sinks 7.6% as Agent Security Expands Its Compute Role
items.summary: OpenShell supports Arm-based processors, while separate infrastructure processors can monitor and isolate autonomous workloads.

items.title: Microsoft’s AI Gains Can Push the Stock Higher. That’s Good News for Software Peers.
items.summary: Microsoft’s Azure business has cleared $100 billion in annual revenue and its stock is on a run. How high can it go?

items.title: Nvidia launches new tool to keep AI agents from going rogue
items.summary: Chipmaker Nvidia said Monday it is introducing a new software platform to address concerns about artificial intelligence agents that have “gone rogue” and operated outside the control of humans. AI researcher Andrew Yoon joins CNN News Central.
